site.notes: Also called Lake Mobutu Sese Seko. Location from: Cohen, A.S. 1987. Fossil ostracodes from Lake Mobutu (L. Albert): paleoecologic and taphonomic implications. Pages 271-281 in K. Heine, editor. Paleoecology of Africa and the surrounding islands. Volume 18. A. A. Balkema, Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

collectionunit.notes: Core taken by the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, 1972 expedition. Description of core lithology from Cohen (1987).

chronology.notes:
Based on IntCal13 calibration curve. Two Bacon models were run, one for the top of the core above the ostracode calcarenite and prsumed hiatus, the other for the bottom of the core below the calcarenite. Bacon would not produce a reasonable model by setting the hiatus parameter. The age of the sample within the  calcarenite was assigned the mean age and total range of model ages for 170 and 190 cm.
